name: Adelaide, Raum's puppet

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Ashen Forbiddance
traits.summary: Can't cross a line of ash made by burning feathers sprinkled with Holy Water.
traits.text: The corvodaemon cannot cross a line of ashes made by burning feathers and sprinkling them with Holy Water.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.summary: Killed outside the Abyss, it dissolves into ichor and revives at full Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.
traits.text: If it dies anywhere but the Abyss, its body melts into ichor and it gains a new body at once, returning with all its Hit Points to some place in the Abyss.

traits.name: Devour Anima
traits.summary: A creature it drops to 0 HP is cursed until it regains any HP; its first failed death save then kills it outright.
traits.text: A creature the corvodaemon reduces to 0 Hit Points is cursed until it regains any Hit Points. When the cursed creature fails a Death Saving Throw at the start of its turn, it dies, however many failures it had.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.summary: Imitates any voice it has heard, or one known to a creature in its telepathy range; a DC 14 Wis (Insight) check sees through it.
traits.text: The corvodaemon can copy the voice of any creature it has heard, or of one that a creature within its telepathy range knows. A listener who succeeds on a DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check can tell it is an imitation.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Feeding Frenzy first if it has recharged, then one Beak and one Claws attack.

actions.name: Claws
actions.summary: +5, 2d4+3 Slashing; a Medium or smaller target falls Prone.

actions.name: Feeding Frenzy
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. Until its next turn its Speed doubles and it gains Temporary Hit Points equal to half the damage it deals.
actions.text: Used as part of its Multiattack. Until the start of its next turn the corvodaemon's Speed is doubled, and whenever it damages a creature it gains Temporary Hit Points equal to half the damage dealt.

summary: Adelaide Langtree, dominated: she moves in Raum's rhythm and her eyes are full of amber.
